instruction: Open the Dinoco Airlines app, check in my next upcoming flight and confirm that the boarding pass screen actually renders. Download it locally as well.
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines and locate the upcoming flights list
Identify the next upcoming (non-cancelled) flight by departure_date
Click the 'Check in' control on that flight's row
Verify the boarding pass view renders with flight number, route, and gate/seat details visible
Download the boarding pass locally

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens Dinoco Airlines and locates the next upcoming (non-cancelled) flight by departure_date in the live booking list
Agent clicks the 'Check in' control on that upcoming flight's row, not on a past or cancelled flight
Agent verifies that the boarding pass view actually renders after check-in (flight number, route, and seat/gate details visible)
Agent downloads the boarding pass locally (e.g., saves the file to disk or confirms a download action was triggered)
Agent reports the boarding pass details (flight number and route) it observed on the rendered pass

instruction: How many miles have I actually flown on Dinoco over the past 12 months? Add up the miles from every completed Dinoco flight in that window. Give me a spreadsheet of each trip, and the miles for each one with a final row of the cumulative miles. Also include the upcoming trips and their milage.
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines and pull the flight history
Filter to flights whose status is completed (not cancelled, not upcoming) within the past 12 months
Sum miles_flown (or miles_earned) across those completed flights
Report the total miles flown with the count of contributing flights
Include upcoming trips and their mileage in the output
Produce a per-trip table or spreadsheet with a cumulative total row

rubrics.criterion: Agent filters Dinoco flight history to flights that are completed (not cancelled and not still-upcoming) within the past 12 months and sums their miles from the live flight history
Agent also lists upcoming Dinoco flights and their mileage alongside the completed-flight data, as explicitly requested
Agent produces a per-trip table or spreadsheet-style breakdown with each trip and its miles, ending with a cumulative total row
Agent reports the count of completed Dinoco flights in the past 12 months and the total miles for that window (even 1-2 flights is a valid result)
Agent delivers a single answer covering completed-flight totals, upcoming-flight mileage, and the per-trip breakdown together

instruction: Book me a one-way Dinoco flight from AVP to JFK in Economy for next Friday with my MasterCard. Make sure you get a seat on the left and a flight in the evening or night. Can you check that the we got a confirmation email for the flight and pull it up?
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines and start a new one-way booking with origin AVP and destination JFK for next Friday
Pick an Economy fare from an evening or night departure
Select a seat on the left side of the aircraft
Pay with Michael's MasterCard
Complete the booking and capture the new confirmation number
Open HooliMail and locate the booking confirmation email; pull it up

rubrics.criterion: Agent creates a new one-way Dinoco booking with origin AVP and destination JFK in the Economy fare class for next Friday
Agent selects an evening or night departure flight (departure time in the evening or after sunset) and picks a seat on the left side of the aircraft
Agent pays with Michael's MasterCard (not a different saved card or a new card entry)
Agent completes the booking and captures the new Dinoco confirmation number returned by the app
Agent confirms a booking confirmation email was received and pulls it up as requested by Michael
Agent delivers a single end-to-end answer: new confirmation number plus confirmation that the booking email was found

instruction: What's my current FlyMiles loyalty tier on Dinoco and how many miles do I have in the bank?
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines and navigate to Michael's loyalty profile
Read the FlyMiles tier label
Read the current miles balance
Report both values together

rubrics.criterion: Agent reads Michael's FlyMiles loyalty tier directly from the live Dinoco profile (not inferred from email or other apps)
Agent reads Michael's current FlyMiles miles balance directly from the live Dinoco profile
Agent reports the loyalty tier and miles balance together in a single answer

instruction: Cancel my next flight on Dinoco. After cancelling, verify we get an email for the cancellation, and pull it up. Let me know what you cancelled and how much credit we received.
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines and pick the next upcoming cancellable booking
Cancel that booking through the Dinoco UI
Open HooliMail and locate the cancellation confirmation email; pull it up
Open the Dinoco travel-credit ledger and confirm a new credit entry was added for the cancelled fare
Report what was cancelled and how much travel credit was received

rubrics.criterion: Agent picks the next upcoming Dinoco booking that is still cancellable (not already past or cancelled) and cancels it through the Dinoco UI
Agent confirms the cancellation confirmation email was received and pulls it up as requested
Agent verifies a new travel-credit entry posts in Dinoco for the cancelled fare and reports the credit amount received
Agent explicitly reports what flight was cancelled (route and/or flight number) and how much credit was received
Agent delivers a single end-to-end answer: cancelled booking details, cancellation email confirmation, and travel-credit amount
